description: Estimate what a public Steam inventory is worth at current Steam Community Market prices: total value, total after Steam's selling fee, and a subtotal per game (Counter-Strike 2, Dota 2, Team Fortress 2, Rust, PUBG, Steam trading cards and more). Takes up to about a minute. The inventory must be public; nothing is changed on the Steam account.

profile.description: Steam profile URL (steamcommunity.com/id/... or /profiles/...), a 17-digit SteamID64, or a custom URL name.

title: Value a Steam inventory
